changes: Added read-only authority policy discovery in the TS CLI: typed authority-policy.v1 parsing, AuthorityClient.discoverPolicy, authority_enforce_policy / authority enforce policy command routing, overclaim rejection, smoke tests, docs, validation handoff, and post-review cleanup.
usage: Run koala authority_enforce_policy --authorityURL=<server> or koala authority enforce policy --authorityURL=<server> to inspect the Python authority /v1/authority/policy contract. This command only discovers policy and does not submit evidence.
expectedOutcome: The command prints the discovery-only disclaimer plus contractVersion authority-policy.v1, requiredAuthorityMode, command/evidence digests, supported modes, and evidencePolicy.preset. Missing authority URL fails non-zero.
actualTranscript: manual TEST validation passed; calls=GET /v1/authority/policy,GET /v1/authority/policy; flat-status=0 nested-status=0 missing-url-status=nonzero. koala validate passed with 15/15 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No product mismatch. Output uses aligned field formatting, which still contains the expected field/value pairs.
limitations: M1 intentionally does not implement actor keys, runner behavior, job claim, EvidenceEnvelope submission, server receipts, receipt verification, L2+ gate promotion, or production authority enforcement.
pitfalls: The first manual verifier script used spawnSync while hosting the fake server in the same Node event loop, causing a self-inflicted timeout; rerunning with async child processes produced the correct pass transcript. Quality review also caught two smoke cleanup issues, both fixed by Claude and re-reviewed.
